items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: I never got to know him. But he was a good piano player, yeah, he was good. I know him and I know a fellow called Jimmy Prye... His name, Mac Mamamara I think his name is.

ctx.x: Another pianist, when you were talking about Galveston and that part of Texas, did you ever run into Lazy Daddy over there? Yeah. Fillmore I guess. Yeah, yeah. How was he?

I never got to know him. But he was a good piano player, yeah, he was good. I know him and I know a fellow called Jimmy Prye, he was another pretty good piano player around that way. And there's another piano player who is living the day, was a very famous piano player among all the piano players because they used to go sit in the show to listen at him play. They used to listen to the guys that didn't read, used to listen at him to catch tunes for him. I mean he was a piano player with use of a lot of harmony and…
